replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a neutral relationship with mathematics. It's not my favorite subject, but I understand its importance, especially in physics, which I enjoy. I find some concepts confusing, but I try to work through them at my own pace.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. Advanced algebra and calculus can be overwhelming, especially when I'm preparing for exams. My moderate neuroticism makes me worry about not understanding concepts thoroughly, but I manage by taking breaks and seeking help.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I briefly used an AI math tutor to practice algebra problems. It was helpful for step-by-step solutions, but I found it less engaging than learning with peers. My low extraversion makes me prefer group study, so I didn't rely on AI much.
